name: TOB TTS Provider
description: Platform config, not per-user data — one row per text-to-speech vendor integration (google, ...). Mirrors TOB AI Provider's shape/trust boundary exactly (System-Manager-only; api_key is a Password field, never returned by any REST response) even though only one vendor exists today, so a second one (Polly, Azure) can be added later as just another row rather than a rewrite. `enabled` also doubles as the single 'is Premium voice offered to students at all' flag the app reads via get_tts_settings.

fields.label: Provider Key
fields.description: Matches the Python module's own provider key constant, e.g. 'google'.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the Premium voice option disappears from the app for everyone (get_tts_settings reports it unavailable) and any direct synthesize call is rejected — the same 'route around a misbehaving provider without a deploy' switch TOB AI Provider already has.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Server-side only. Read via frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password() — never exposed through any whitelisted method's return value. A blank value submitted on save leaves the stored key unchanged (see api/tts.py:set_tts_provider_settings).

fields.label: Voice Type
fields.description: Admin bookkeeping/pricing tier for now — synthesis requests only send a bare language code (no voice name), which Google typically resolves to a Standard-tier voice regardless of this setting. A real per-tier voice picker is a future enhancement, not built yet.

fields.label: Price per Million Characters (USD)
fields.description: Used to compute estimated_cost_usd on every TOB TTS Usage Log row. Set from Google's own published pricing for the voice_type above; not hardcoded in code since Google's pricing changes independently of any deploy.

fields.label: Character Limit per Request
fields.description: Server-side guardrail — a synthesize call for longer text than this is rejected before it ever reaches Google, so a full long article/lesson body can't be sent (and billed) uncapped.
